newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Petrobras to double depth record.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Petrobras to double depth record.

text.p: Brazilian oil monopoly Petrobras will be producing petroleum from wells up to 2,000 meters deep by the year 2000, the company's president said.

"Today we are producing at depths of 1,027 meters and we are prepared to produce in 1,700 meters 1997 and 2,000 meters by 2000," Joel Renno said during a ceremony in Brasilia's presidential palace to launch a deep-sea technology center.

President Fernando Henrique Cardoso, whose government is in the process of allowing private companies to associate and compete with Petrobras, said the state-owned firm would lead deep-sea exploration in Brazil and around the world.
